sections.title: When You Can Cancel
sections.content: You can cancel your order for a full refund at any time, provided the order status is currently listed as Pending or Accepted.
sections.restrictions: Once an order status updates to 'Ready to Be Shipped', it can no longer be canceled.

sections.title: Payment Verification & Refunds
sections.content: Refunds are processed after our system verifies that your initial payment has successfully cleared.
sections.note: Once verified, the credit will be issued back to your original payment method.

sections.title: How to Cancel
sections.content: Log into your account dashboard, navigate to your order history, and select the cancellation option next to your eligible order.
